scripts.dev: npm run build -w @kidsapp/shared && concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run start -w @kidsapp/mobile"
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build -w @kidsapp/shared && npm run start -w @kidsapp/mobile
scripts.build:android: npm run build -w @kidsapp/shared && npm run build:android -w @kidsapp/mobile
scripts.build:android:preview: npm run build -w @kidsapp/shared && npm run build:android:preview -w @kidsapp/mobile
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kidsapp/shared && npm run build -w server
